recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast image of a wooden berry basket overflowing with vibrant, saturated pink raspberries against a clean, off-white background. The composition features arched typography following the curve of the fruit and a secondary stamped-style text on the basket's side.
coreVisualRelationships: The arched text follows the organic contour of the piled fruit.
The warm brown of the wooden basket anchors the intense magenta of the berries.
The horizontal grey rim of the basket creates a sharp division between the organic fruit and the geometric container.
coreInvariants: Natural wood grain texture on the basket
Arched display text following the top curve of the fruit pile

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered subject occupying 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular wooden basket base provides a stable foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant pink fruit, follow the arched text curve, and drop down to the stamped text on the basket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean, neutral off-white background surrounding the central object.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (arched text) and Dark Purple (stamped text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in the subject against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy slab serif with high contrast.
Secondary text uses a condensed, industrial stencil or stamp aesthetic.
Primary text is individually rotated to follow a circular arc.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the arc are spaced widely to cover the width of the fruit pile.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a classic slab serif with a utilitarian industrial stamp.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and vintage feel of the primary text.
Captures the industrial, stamped look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered wooden berry basket filled with a high-piled mound of bright magenta raspberries. The basket has a thin grey rim. The background is a solid, clean off-white. Lighting is flat and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold white slab serif text in a wide arch following the top curve of the raspberries. Place a smaller, dark purple industrial-style stamped text on the right side of the wooden basket face, tilted slightly clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta of the berries highly saturated?
Does the primary text follow the curve of the fruit?
Is the secondary text angled like a rubber stamp?
Is the background a neutral off-white?

adjustableVariables: Arc radius of the primary text
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text arch matches the fruit mound curvature.
Ensure the wood texture looks natural and not tiled.
Verify the magenta doesn't clip into pure red.
Confirm the stamped text looks like it is on the surface of the wood.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Fruit in Container) + Arched Slab Serif + Stamped Secondary Text + High Saturation/Neutral Background Contrast.
